subject: general
question:
The Bar graph shows four different toys (Bicycle, Train, Car & Bus) manufactured by ABC Pvt Ltd. company in 3 consecutive years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b96b1fe1c2f6dafb2c120e7beeff091ec7e667047272191a6c174d2b62ff0c4b.png] 

What is the ratio between the sum of cars and trains manufactured in 2017 and 2018 to the total number of buses manufactured in 2016, 2017 and 2018 together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The sum of cars and trains manufactured in 2017 and 2018 = 1600 + 2600 + 1800 + 2000 = 8000

Total number of buses manufactured in 2016, 2017 and 2018 together = 2000 + 1600 + 3000 = 6600

Ratio = 8000 : 6600

⇒ 40 : 33

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
